disputed_verses.BHSA NEH 12:35: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בַּחֲצֹצְרֹ֑ות זְכַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־יֹֽונָתָ֜ן בֶּן־שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה בֶּן־מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־מִ֣יכָיָ֔ה בֶּן־זַכּ֖וּר בֶּן־אָסָֽף׃
disputed_verses.KJV NEH 12:35: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

first_reader_said: NEH 12:35: Both records are Mattaniah ben Micaiah, father of Shemaiah, at the same point of the Asaphite pedigree in 12:35.

why: 2CH 29:13 names an Asaphite Levite serving in Hezekiah’s time, centuries before the Nehemiah-era Zechariah whose great-grandfather Mattaniah appears in NEH 12:35. NEH 12:35 supplies A’s Micaiah–Mattaniah–Shemaiah genealogy; B’s matching father comes from its misplaced assignment of that same verse, rather than independent evidence identifying the two men.
